title: cli/dev: on an `os dev` boot with `OS_PORT` set, served connector metadata reads the build-time `baseUrl` (`http://127.0.0.1:3000`) while dispatch reaches the live port, so `/meta` disagrees with what runs
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once at a public door. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-steve` · session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** A developer running `os dev` on an isolated port (QA, CI, a second checkout) reads a connector's `baseUrl` from `/api/v1/meta/connector/…` (Studio, an agent, a QA runner) and sees `3000`, while the flow it debugs actually calls the live port. This is the address mix-up #7538 was filed to end, now moved from dispatch to the metadata read. A runner that trusts `/meta` blames the wrong address or the sandbox, which is the expensive misdiagnosis #7538 records.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:devx` seat: `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` (whether an `os dev` artifact boot re-resolves env-derived connector config, or recompiles) and the header claim in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/self-url.ts`.

## Measured

- **reach (public door):** QA run #25817 at `6679644a`, with `OS_PORT=41302` exported on `os dev`: `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/showcase_status_api` answered `baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:3000`, while the live `connector_action` reached 41302. It was not re-measured by the seat. Recorded in the os-dev report on PR #26109 (comment 6416286751, out_of_scope_findings[1]).
- Reading of `main` `1bbb7bf4`:
  - `examples/app-showcase/src/system/self-url.ts` resolves `SHOWCASE_SELF_URL`, then `OS_PORT`/`PORT`, then the `3000` literal, at module evaluation, so a prebuilt `dist/objectstack.json` carries whatever the build-time environment gave.
  - `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` boots the artifact. The served metadata therefore carries the build-time value, while the dispatch path resolves at run time.

## Expected

- On an `os dev` boot, the connector `baseUrl` served by `/meta` equals the one dispatch uses, or `self-url.ts` stops claiming that the `os dev` value follows the live environment and says the served value is build-time.
- A pin: an `os dev` boot with `OS_PORT` other than 3000 reads `showcase_status_api`'s served `baseUrl` on that port.

## Dedupe

Query on this repo (open and closed): "os dev serves build-time connector baseUrl 3000 while dispatch uses OS_PORT showcase_status_api" returned 9 hits. #7538 (closed) is the dispatch half this follows, and #26088 (open) is the docs port contradiction; neither is this defect.
